adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and uses them directly in `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no bounds checks. This enables `limit=0`, which then propagates to the client: `admin-group.js.es6` computes `currentPage`/`totalPages` via `Math.floor(offset / limit)` and `Math.floor(user_count / limit)`, causing `Infinity/NaN` when `limit` is 0. Negative `offset`/`limit` are also not prevented and can trigger DB/AR errors (e.g., negative OFFSET). There is also no cap on `limit`, so very large values can bypass intended pagination.
